moments.name: Fener Yolu
moments.s07: lane mist <=0.3 m a<=0.12 (band a<=0.2) drifting +x; dry bamboo leaves <=12/frame; motes in Shaft_01/02; chochin sway +-4 deg gust-phased along wind; warm drip glints r<=1 m; M1_L02 halo a 0.08

moments.name: Hanafubuki

moments.name: Nobetcinin Lambasi
moments.s07: door light-shaft card a<=0.12 + 15-30 motes; warm eave-drip glints inside the wedge; static cold fog pocket x45-52 z52-54.5 <=0.3 m a<=0.10 #9AA6B2; 0-2 sparks at sconce

moments.name: Yagmur Aynasi
moments.s07: puddle reflection (sky dome + lantern silhouettes); per axis flame a -z streak 2.0x0.12 m a 0.4 synced to LanternFlames; 0.3 m dark wet rim; drip rings <=12/frame; footstep rings player+zombie <=16/frame d0.2-0.7 m 0.6 s; R27/R28 flow 0.35 m/s south with sun glints

moments.name: Son Duanin Isigi
moments.s07: R1 south shoji transmission (v<=0.78, #E8C89A); lit eave-drip curtain r 2.5 m around lamps <=40 drops 1.5 cm, step rings <=12/frame; tsuri pendulum +-3 deg 0.37 Hz gust-driven; <=4 paper particles lift on gusts and tumble +x; 0-3 sparks per lamp

moments.name: Fener Ev
moments.s07: R4 shoji transmission (v<=0.78); roof-vent smoke per LB 5 at (-32,-36) fading at 7 m + hibachi steam; wet stepping stones roughness 0.45; eave drips glint in shoji light
moments.layoutNote: M6_L02 oribe (−37,6; −29,4): R4 K kapı önlüğü ve R10 dışında.

moments.name: Hic Baslamayan Bayram
moments.rule: if GC E3 west pillar is built at (-12.4,28.0), omit M7_L04
moments.s07: 8 lanterns sway +-5 deg, phase = position along wind dir (gust wave walks left to right); rope sag +-3 cm; halo d0.7 a0.12 per lantern; paper glow 1.3 Hz noise flicker; sparse lit drips under lanterns
moments.layoutNote: E3 batı kazaridaru (−12,4; 25,8)'de (GC'deki 28,0 değil): L04 korunur (yığının 0,85 m kuzeyinde, 2,7 m yükseklikte).

moments.name: Toro Nagashi
moments.s07: toro bob +-1 cm 0.3 Hz, yaw +-5 deg, slow drift r<=0.4 m around placement 2-4 cm/s; ring per toro every 3-5 s d0.3-0.8 m; reflection (planar/SSR/probe) else 0.15x0.6 m fake streak per toro; water mist <=0.4 m a<=0.10; foam+flow at C38a/b (M4 link); LanternFlames scan adds group M8_toro for flicker
